text:
Marco: Quick UX review — compact threshold editor edge cases. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/compact-thresholds (see notes).
Amy: Nice catch. Two quick things: focus ring on the inline input is nearly invisible on light theme. Also when the dropdown for operator (>=, <=) opens, tabbing sometimes traps you.
Jess: Copy nit: the inline label currently reads 'Threshold' — users confuse that with 'SLO target'. Maybe use 'Alert threshold (e.g. 99.9%)' as placeholder?
Kevin: Re: tab trap, probably because we render the dropdown in-place. We can portal it to body and manage focus, but that adds z-index/test overhead. For the number input we can also allow arrow keys to increment/decrement.
Tiffany: For suppression mapping: when someone toggles 'Suppress if in maintenance' we currently show a full modal to pick channels. That's heavy. Can we do an inline quick picker and a tiny 'more options' link to open advanced modal?
Amy: +1 to inline picker. Also accessibility note: the toggle needs aria-describedby pointing to the suppression rationale tooltip.
Design Bot: Pushed updated frames: https://figma.redwood/compact-thresholds#frame=3 — added clearer focus, increased hit target from 24px to 32px for inline controls.
A11y Team: Please add an aria-live region so the preview panel announces 'Preview updated' when changes apply. Also ensure color contrast of the status chip meets 4.5:1 for normal text.
Kevin: Implementation question: for the 'preview' we currently debounce at 500ms. If we reduce debounce to 250ms to feel snappier, that may increase load on the preview renderer. Thoughts?
Marco: Tradeoff ok if we guard with rate limit and show a spinner for longer-running previews.
Jess: UX detail on the preview: when a user changes operator from '<' to '<=', the sample incident count should animate or highlight changed rows, otherwise folks miss the delta.
Amy: Microcopy: replace 'Notify' button text with 'Send alert to channel' for clarity in the picker. Also change 'Add suppression' to 'Add temporary suppression' to set expectation.
Kevin: Dev estimate: portal dropdown + focus management + aria-live = 2 d. Inline picker + microcopy work = 1 d. Preview highlight animation = 1 d. Debounce tuning + guard = 0.5 d.
Tiffany: Can we also add a keyboard shortcut to open the channel picker (e.g., Cmd+K when a control is focused)? Useful for power users.
Marco: Good idea — add to backlog.
Amy: I'll update the mocks tonight with the focus states, new copy, and small picker variant. Assigning to Kevin for estimate follow-up.
Marco: Thanks all — let's aim to merge designs by EOD Friday. If anyone spots other edge cases, drop them here. :thumbsup:
